narrative.intro: Kiewit Infrastructure South has $387M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Kiewit Infrastructure South has won 3 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $129M. Kiewit Infrastructure South received the bulk of obligations from three agencies: the Department of Agriculture, National Aeronautics and Space Administration, and the Department of Defense. Kiewit Infrastructure South’s work is concentrated in two NAICS markets: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction. Kiewit Infrastructure South recorded $297M in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction obligations and $90.3M in Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction obligations. Kiewit Infrastructure South’s largest buying agency is the Department of Agriculture with $261M in obligations, followed by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration with $90.3M and the Department of Defense with $36M. Kiewit Infrastructure South’s FY2026 obligations are the only nonzero fiscal-year entry listed, with FY21 through FY25 recorded as $0.
